text: Their newest ads are pretty awesome. Surface's dancing ad [LINK] , the IE9 dubstep [LINK] , the IE10 troll [VIDEO] , and the various Windows 8 international musical ads (the wave after the countdown ad) [LINK] [LINK] and [LINK] are definitely a step way up from previous ad campaigns that Microsoft launched. All in all, the Windows 8 ads are IMO fresh, and definitely leaning more towards the younger adult hip side. And they're pulling it off pretty nicely.
That comment reminded me of the Microsoft ad video targeted at web devs. [VIDEO] Interesting and funny video, regardless of if you think anything changed.

story: Ask HN: What would it take for IE not to be hated?
text: Direct link to video for others who don't read TechCrunch: [VIDEO] I don't hate IE, but for me to consider start using it, it would need to run on all major platforms and be open ala Chrome and Firefox. Otherwise, I don't see the point.

story: Microsoft hires designer behind "The Next Microsoft", Andrew Kim
text: A few days ago, a Microsoft employee who has worked on Windows 7 and 8 said on a Reddit AMA: "There is no doubt that we have catching up to do.
